review.scientific: Internal scientific pass checked morphology and cell-type distinction, compartment model, endothelial capture/rolling/arrest/diapedesis, direction versus speed, uptake versus viable killing, oxidase/MPO, tissue resident origin, complement functions and terminal regulation, antibody recognition versus Fc function, resolution and comparative examples. Reviewed all 52 answer mappings. Recomputed absolute counts 4800/4000, directional 0.60/0.20, dilution 1.25 and 11.11%, B-cell count 1.08×10^9/L, sequential 20%, arrests 37.5%/50%, speed 15 µm/min, efficiency −0.20, balance −200/h, receptor occupancy 0.50/0.75; other teaching illustrations are hypothetical and distinguished from source evidence.
review.editorial: Distinct pass reviewed ordered sections and linked scope, corrected blood-group sequence wording, strengthened B-question explanations and changed answer order (5 each A–D), clarified mast cell comparison, corrected differential-count figure axes and labels, added comparative reference links and mobile table scrolling, adjusted answer spacing, retained inherited reader shell. Final audit 159 unique paragraphs and all 52 explained answers.

score_basis: Internal assessment: scientific 19 (source records and selected authoritative text rather than every full-text primary paper); coverage 15 (complete mapped roadmap); depth 15 (saved word count and 13 substantive sections); pedagogy 10 (progressive context, mechanisms, evidence and reasoning); illustrations 9 (11 titled/described original figures including corrected count graph; static review only); assessment 9 (all answers inspected, some straightforward Part B distractors, Part C includes constructed response); analysis 5 (conditional, quantitative and causal interpretation); revision 5 (checklist, equations, comparison and active recall); reader 4 (static checks, runtime/browser not tested); technical 4 (static validation, live and responsive rendering pending). Not external certification.
